newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Pipeline explosion in southwestern Russia - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Pipeline explosion in southwestern Russia - Tass.

text.p: An explosion on a gas pipeline in southwestern Russia on Sunday sent flames shooting 30 metres (100 feet) into the air, Itar-Tass news agency said.
It said the blast occurred on a stretch of pipeline close to the town of Maloyaroslavlets. No one was injured but emergency services were still fighting the blaze.
The Ministry for Emergency Situations declined to comment on the incident.
Itar-Tass said the cause of the blast was not yet known. A similar explosion occurred in the same area on January 28.
